headline: Software standardizes LC-MS/MS quality control, imaging data, and metabolite annotation
label: Mass Spectrometry Analysis Software
summary: Accessible, vendor-neutral tools now cover instrument QC, mass spectrometry imaging integration, and curated microbial metabolite annotation.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that standardizes or automates analysis around existing mass spectrometry data. MaSpeQC is a free, vendor-agnostic interactive web app that tracks LC-MS/MS performance across proteomic, metabolomic, and lipidomic QC samples. CMMC-KB, a community-curated knowledgebase of microbial metabolites, links LC-MS/MS untargeted metabolomics output to downstream tools, extending the same logic to metabolite annotation. Thyra converts mass spectrometry imaging data into the SpatialData format, integrating MSI into spatial omics workflows through modular components. VenomsBase, a FAIR-aligned modular cloud platform, similarly integrates multi-omics and ecological metadata for venomous species. What is new is the scope of reuse: vendor-neutral QC, shared curated reference resources, and interoperable data formats are offered as accessible tools.
